description:
Configure the email templates for the '2024 SIOP Annual Conference Feedback' survey. Log in to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!) and navigate to the survey's Email Templates section. 

1. Customize the **Invitation Email**:
   - Subject: 'Your Feedback Matters: 2024 SIOP Annual Conference Survey'
   - Body must include:
     - Greeting: 'Dear {FIRSTNAME} {LASTNAME},'
     - Text: 'Thank you for attending the 2024 SIOP Annual Conference in Chicago. Your feedback is essential to improving future conferences.'
     - Text: 'Please complete our brief survey by clicking the link below:'
     - Link placeholder: '{SURVEYURL}'
     - Text: 'This survey will take approximately 10 minutes to complete.'
     - Sign-off: 'Dr. Elena Voss, Conference Program Chair'
     - Opt-out link: '{OPTOUTURL}'

2. Customize the **Reminder Email**:
   - Subject: 'Reminder: We Still Need Your Conference Feedback - Closing Soon'
   - Body must include:
     - Greeting: 'Dear {FIRSTNAME},'
     - Text: 'We noticed you haven't yet completed our conference feedback survey.'
     - Text: 'The survey will close in 72 hours'
     - Link placeholder: '{SURVEYURL}'
     - Opt-out link: '{OPTOUTURL}'

3. Customize the **Confirmation Email**:
   - Subject: 'Thank You for Your 2024 SIOP Conference Feedback'
   - Body must include:
     - Greeting: 'Dear {FIRSTNAME},'
     - Text: 'Your responses have been successfully recorded.'
     - Text: 'Your input will directly shape the program for SIOP 2025.'

4. Update **General Settings**:
   - Administrator email: 'conferences@siop-feedback.org'
   - Bounce email: 'bounce@siop-feedback.org'
